title: Formal requirements.
bodyText: A letter of credit, confirmation, advice, transfer, amendment, or cancellation may be issued in any form that is a signed record.
bodyHtml: §490:5-104  Formal requirements.  A letter of credit, confirmation, advice, transfer, amendment, or cancellation may be issued in any form that is a signed record. [L 1996, c 39, pt of §1; am L 2023, c 132, §26]
